title: Geometry Quiz
description: Practice perimeter, area, angles, circles, the Pythagorean theorem and volume with ten questions that build up step by step.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 7 cm long and 3 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter is the distance all the way around. 7 + 3 + 7 + 3 = 20 cm. 21 is the area, not the perimeter.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 9 m long and 4 m wide?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length × width. 9 × 4 = 36 m². 26 m is the perimeter.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10 cm and a height of 6 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height. ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 cm². Getting 60 means you forgot to halve.

questions.question: Two angles in a triangle are 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles in a triangle add up to 180°. 180° − 50° − 60° = 70°.

questions.question: A circle has a diameter of 10 cm. What is its circumference? Use π ≈ 3.14.
A circle has a radius of 3 cm. What is its area? Use π ≈ 3.14.
questions.explanation: Area = π × r². 3² = 9, and 3.14 × 9 = 28.26 cm². Using the diameter, 6, instead of the radius gives 113.04, which is four times too big.

questions.question: A right triangle has shorter sides of 6 cm and 8 cm. How long is the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: Use a² + b² = c². 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100, so c = √100 = 10 cm. Don't forget the square root at the end.

questions.question: What is the volume of a box that is 5 cm long, 4 cm wide and 3 cm high?
questions.explanation: Volume of a box = length × width × height. 5 × 4 × 3 = 60 cm³.

questions.question: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of 13 cm and one shorter side of 5 cm. How long is the other shorter side?
questions.explanation: Subtract the squares, because you are finding a shorter side. 13² − 5² = 169 − 25 = 144, and √144 = 12 cm.

questions.question: A cylinder has a radius of 2 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is its volume? Use π ≈ 3.14.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × height. 3.14 × 2² × 10 = 3.14 × 4 × 10 = 125.6 cm³.
